title: Inspect runner subcommand help after a zero-match source-code search
failure_signature: A narrow source search assumed argparse labels that were not present in the repository wrapper and exited with no matches.
trigger_preconditions: narrow implementation search returned no matches
candidate_workaround: Use executable help as the source of truth when a compatibility wrapper delegates implementation.
recurrence_guard: Do not treat zero text matches as proof that a delegated CLI lacks a capability.
rollback: Withdraw the source-search inference and make no ledger call until help succeeds.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
